To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

copper island films can be prepared by thermal evapora-tion in vacuum, that their optical constants can be measured, and that optical multilayers with incorporated copper island layers can be designed and fabricated.
optical multilayer films can be prepared with incorporated copper island film layers.
the optical constants of copper island films can be used for the design of optical coatings, which are applicable for attenuator and color filter specifications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new class of optical coatings which are based on copper island films and which are suitable as optical filters or attenuators.
the development of optical coatings with a new kind of optical material, namely, a metal island film.
the development of new optical materials with tunable optical properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
copper island films have been successfully used for the preparation of high performance optical multilayer films.
the copper island films are very promising materials for optical coating applications.
the optical constants of copper island films are strongly dependent on the island morphology and the island morphology can be influenced by the deposition parameters.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
copper island films are suitable for optical coating applications.
optical coatings with incorporated island films are promising candidates for the realization of optical attenuators or color filters.
copper island films can be used as optical components in the visible spectral range.
The main takeaway from our work is that
optical properties of island films can be tailored by varying the film structure and that the island films can be used as optical materials in optical coatings.
the optical properties of island films can be tailored to a large extent by controlling the island morphology.
